premises.text: Professionals often forget to bill calls made on their mobile phones, leading to significant financial losses.
premises.evidence_span: over time, this adds up into huge losses

premises.text: A significant portion of billable time spent on mobile calls goes unbilled.
premises.evidence_span: roughly 40% of the time professionals that bill by the hour spend talking on a mobile phone goes unbilled

premises.text: A mobile app can simplify the billing process for calls by automatically tracking them.
premises.evidence_span: our app automatically starts tracking that call for billing

premises.text: The app has gained significant traction with a large number of downloads and monthly users.
premises.evidence_span: we've got over 30,000 downloads, roughly 5,000 monthly users

value.text: Professionals can effectively bill for their time spent on mobile calls.
value.evidence_span: you press our button when you receive the call instead of pressing the green button when mom calls

notes: Traction metrics and funding request excluded as they do not represent premises.
